name: endurance-hold
description: Long single-current endurance: 1.5 A punch through the L(f) band and ~17.5 s sustained hold at the no-load voltage ceiling, 1 kHz capture. No torque steps: a down-step AT the ceiling reproducibly kills the estimation chain (6/6 on endurance-20s at t=4.0 — estimator-session reproducer); this variant validates sustained closed-loop drive, the affirm/deadman path and telemetry endurance instead.
